items.title: What Is Apple (AAPL) Planning With Its New Autonomous AI Agent?
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is building an autonomous AI agent designed to handle complex, multistep tasks for everyday users. Job postings point to a large scale buildout of AI engineering and product roles tied directly to this new assistant effort. Internal planning targets a potential consumer launch as soon as late 2027 with a core focus on on device privacy and security. Apple's autonomous AI agent push under CEO John Ternus fits into a broader shift our research is tracking at the company...
